task.title: To make a clause smart in a template

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
From the Contracts pane, click the Home button () and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to Work > Clauses.
The Clauses pane lists all the clauses present in your template. Select a clause from the list and click the settings button () next to the clause name .
In the Properties pane, toggle the Smart Clause switch on and click Save.

note.p: When you enable the Read-Only Clause attribute, the value of the Smart Clause attribute is disabled.

postreq.p: Your template clause will now have the smartness property. To remove the smartness property of a clause, toggle theSmart Clause switch off (greyed out).
